title: Use a multi-network only where the kinds of links are the story.
rule: Use a multi-network, a reference form, to draw more than one kind of link among the same nodes, such as shared money and shared staff among a set of groups. Give each kind of link its own line style, solid or dashed, in one ink, name each style in a key, and keep to three kinds; past that, draw one panel for each kind with every node in the same place.
use_when: A specialist asks how two or three kinds of ties overlap among the same people or groups.

use_instead.when: One kind of link with an amount

text: Line styles tell kinds apart in grayscale and for readers who see color differently, where a hue for each kind would fail. More than three kinds tangle, and panels with fixed places keep each kind readable.
why.basis: Design judgment, from the chart system our founder and editor approved in November 2026

builders: No kit form: draw a multi-network with K.parts.node and K.parts.link, one dash a kind of link, in the context ink.
sketch_alt: Five nodes joined by solid lines for one kind of tie and dashed lines for another, each kind named in a key.
